acceptance_criteria.statement: The 2 mm offset tape crosses the nominal tape where the geodesic re-integrated from its measured start pose crosses (near the focal point F0)
acceptance_criteria.test: crossing arclength (linear interpolation between the two stations whose separations change sign, applied alike to the measured and the re-integrated predicted separations) within the T140 expanded uncertainty of the focal distance (conditioned row)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Conditioned on the measured start pose, the measured separations follow the Jacobi prediction, not the flat-plate one
acceptance_criteria.test: E_n <= 1 at stations 1..8 against the prediction re-integrated from the CMM start pose, with U_p from dome tolerances, the start-pose estimate and solver error (T138) and U_m from the camera pair; E_n > 1 against the flat-plate prediction at the last two stations

procedure.action: Soak the specimen and its holder for 4 h at 20 +/- 1 C; log air and part temperature every 10 min.
outputs: environment log with an explicit UTC offset

procedure.action: Check the instruments before the acquisition: the camera images SB-1000; the tracker measures the SB-1000 end points with its SMR; the CMM probes GS-25.4 at 25 points; the scanner scans GS-25.4. Retain every check.
procedure.check: each artifact reading lies within 2 U of its certificate value, U from the declared instrument uncertainty; otherwise stop and recalibrate

procedure.action: Locate the specimen in FX-321 (3-2-1 nest); clamp; probe datum A (3 points), B (2 points) and C (1 point) with the CMM and build the PART frame (datum_frame_321).
Measure the four datum targets of FX-321 (a 1.5 in SMR seated on each) with the tracker to register FIXTURE in WORLD (frame chain).
outputs: WORLD -> FIXTURE transform and its covariance

procedure.action: Scan the coupon surface with the scanner following protocol MFG-SCAN-01 (T129) to identify the as-built dome and its covariance before laying the tapes.

Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape N; lay tape N from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape N: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape N with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows N-S0 and N-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows N-S0 and N-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape N at the nine stations s = k L / 8.
Measure the targets on tape N with the camera, with SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; export their coordinates as rows N0-N8 of the photogrammetry capture.
Repeat steps 3, 7 and 9 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape N; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape N; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape N.

Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape L; lay tape L from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape L: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape L with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows L-S0 and L-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows L-S0 and L-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape L at the nine stations s = k L / 8.
Measure the targets on tape L with the camera, with SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; export their coordinates as rows L0-L8 of the photogrammetry capture.
Repeat steps 3, 13 and 15 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape L; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape L; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape L.

Seat the start jig JIG-START-01 against datums B and C with the insert of tape H; lay tape H from its slot without in-plane steering (a robot may carry the tape head but must not steer it; never draw a path traced from the model); remove the jig. No other tape is on the specimen.
outputs: tape H: identity and laying time

procedure.action: Probe the centreline of tape H with the CMM at s = 0 and s = 20 mm; export the points as rows H-S0 and H-S20 of the cmm capture.
outputs: cmm capture rows H-S0 and H-S20 (ciw.lab-mfg-target-capture.v1)

procedure.action: Place 6 mm coded targets on the centreline of tape H at the nine stations s = k L / 8.
Measure the targets on tape H with the camera, with SB-1000 and the FX-321 datum targets (coded adapters) in every image set; export their coordinates as rows H0-H8 of the photogrammetry capture.
Repeat steps 3, 19 and 21 twice more, removing the specimen from FX-321 and re-seating it between repeats (replicates of tape H; the tape and its targets stay in place).
outputs: two further replicates (replicates of tape H; the tape and its targets stay in place)

procedure.action: Remove the targets and tape H.

purpose: Measure the separation of exactly offset robot paths across a dome, where positive curvature focuses laterally offset paths so that they cross the nominal path inside the coupon.

raw_formats.coordinates: CAD (model) frame through the declared PART -> CAD placement
raw_formats.header: lines '# key: value' for schema, protocol, instrument, frame, unit, origin; unit mm; origin measurement or synthetic (a synthetic capture starts with '# SYNTHETIC CAPTURE - NOT A MEASUREMENT')
raw_formats.reader: ciw.lab.manufacturing_records.read_capture; T138 reduces the lateral tape targets to separations (projection on the model's in-surface normal of the nominal route) and compares them (H2)
raw_formats.uncertainty: u_mm is the declared standard uncertainty of each row (positive); for targets, of each coordinate in the common frame, including the registration of its image set

required_raw_data: raw camera images (lossless) with exposure metadata and SHA-256 digests
tracker/CMM native point files with instrument serial and firmware
calibration certificates of scale bars, gauge sphere and step gauge (digest and validity window)
frame-chain transforms with covariances as computed at the time of measurement

operator, fixture and specimen identities; clock source and synchronization method

tape_layout.rules: tapes on the specimen together: centrelines at least a tape width plus a target diameter apart; slots used in one laying: at least one slot width apart; every tape centreline clears each specimen marker and datum probe point by half the wider of tape and target plus half a marker (manufacturing_records._tape_layout, on the predicted centrelines)
tape_layout.sequence: one tape on the specimen at a time: seat the start jig with that tape's insert, lay the tape, remove the jig, measure the tape and its targets (with re-seated replicates) and remove them before the next tape is laid; every tape is measured in the PART frame of the specimen's own datums
